5. Applicability of State laws to ORV
In response to the comments on this subject, the final environmental statement and the Departmental regulations provide for the applicability of State laws and regulations to the operating requirements for ORV operators and ORV vehicle standards.
6. Recognition of State and local government interests
The Department will continue to work closely with State and local governments in its administration of Interior lands and the management of ORV use. Appropriate provisions have been made in the Departmental ORV regulations to provide for proper access to Interior lands by State and local governments.
7. Public participation in the rulemaking process concerning ORV
The Department recognizes the importance of public participation in the rulemaking process and will continue its policy of informing the public of proposed actions and regulations concerning Interior lands, through advance public notices, meetings, and hearings. All comments received by the Department will be given consideration prior to final actions and regulations. Specific provisions are provided in the Departmental policies and regulations concerning the procedures to be followed in informing the public and soliciting public participation in proposed actions regarding Interior lands.
8. Designation of lands on a "one-time" basis
The Department has made provisions in its ORV regulations which provide for the redesignation of any public lands, including those designated as open to ORV use, at any time hereafter if it is determined by the administering bureau that redesignation is appropriate.
9. Define ambiguous terms, such as "excessive speeds, excessive noise, etc.".
We believe that any directions for operating conditions for ORV, at this time, must be general; therefore, the sense of "reasonableness" is left to the authorized official.
